import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_61/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_61/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)  # Columns: ['Mouse ID', 'Drug']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)  # Columns: ['Mouse ID', 'Timepoint', 'Tumor Volume (mm3)', 'Metastatic Sites']

# Operation 1: JOIN on "Mouse ID"
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="Mouse ID", how="inner")

# Operation 2: PIVOT
# We want to pivot so that each Drug becomes a column, indexed by Timepoint,
# and values are the Tumor Volume (mm3).
# According to target schema, columns are: Timepoint (int), and drugs as float columns.

# Pivot table:
pivot_df = df_joined.pivot_table(
    index="Timepoint",
    columns="Drug",
    values="Tumor Volume (mm3)",
    aggfunc='mean'  # Use mean in case of multiple entries per Timepoint and Drug
)

# Reset index to make Timepoint a column again
pivot_df = pivot_df.reset_index()

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
# Target drugs columns: 'Capomulin', 'Ceftamin', 'Infubinol', 'Ketapril', 'Naftisol',
# 'Placebo', 'Propriva', 'Ramicane', 'Stelasyn', 'Zoniferol'

# Some drugs may be missing in the pivot columns, add them with NaN if needed
target_drugs = ['Capomulin', 'Ceftamin', 'Infubinol', 'Ketapril', 'Naftisol',
                'Placebo', 'Propriva', 'Ramicane', 'Stelasyn', 'Zoniferol']

# Ensure all target drug columns exist in pivot_df, add missing with NaN
for drug in target_drugs:
    if drug not in pivot_df.columns:
        pivot_df[drug] = pd.NA

# Reorder columns: Timepoint first, then drugs in target order
pivot_df = pivot_df[['Timepoint'] + target_drugs]

# Convert Timepoint to integer type (as in target schema)
pivot_df['Timepoint'] = pivot_df['Timepoint'].astype(int)

# Convert drug columns to float (they may contain NaN)
pivot_df[target_drugs] = pivot_df[target_drugs].astype(float)

# Save the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_61/target_multisource.csv"
pivot_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_61/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_61/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on Mouse ID
joined = pd.merge(source1, source0, on="Mouse ID", how="inner")

# Pivot: create columns for each Drug with mean Tumor Volume per Timepoint
pivot = joined.pivot_table(
    index="Timepoint",
    columns="Drug",
    values="Tumor Volume (mm3)",
    aggfunc="mean"
).reset_index()

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
pivot.columns.name = None  # remove the name of columns index
pivot = pivot.rename(columns={
    'Capomulin': 'Capomulin',
    'Ceftamin': 'Ceftamin',
    'Infubinol': 'Infubinol',
    'Ketapril': 'Ketapril',
    'Naftisol': 'Naftisol',
    'Placebo': 'Placebo',
    'Propriva': 'Propriva',
    'Ramicane': 'Ramicane',
    'Stelasyn': 'Stelasyn',
    'Zoniferol': 'Zoniferol'
})

# Some drugs may be missing in the pivot columns, add them with NaN if needed
for drug in ['Capomulin', 'Ceftamin', 'Infubinol', 'Ketapril', 'Naftisol', 'Placebo', 'Propriva', 'Ramicane', 'Stelasyn', 'Zoniferol']:
    if drug not in pivot.columns:
        pivot[drug] = float('nan')

# Group by Timepoint and aggregate mean for each drug column (already done by pivot_table, but to ensure)
result = pivot.groupby("Timepoint", as_index=False).agg({
    'Capomulin': 'mean',
    'Ceftamin': 'mean',
    'Infubinol': 'mean',
    'Ketapril': 'mean',
    'Naftisol': 'mean',
    'Placebo': 'mean',
    'Propriva': 'mean',
    'Ramicane': 'mean',
    'Stelasyn': 'mean',
    'Zoniferol': 'mean'
})

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_61/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
